column2: (b) In the event of a vacancy due to the death, resignation,
incapacity or removal from office of an office bearer, the
Board shall, having regard to the rules of the Corporation,
elect or appoint a person to fill such vacancy; and
(c) The person elected or appointed under paragraph (b)
shall hold office only for the unexpired portion of the term
of office of the member whom he succeeds.
